name: Becky Call
source:
Becky is the main star of Murder Miss Terri and Honor's co-star. She looks down on others and wants nothing more than to win an award for her acting. Even so, she is a good person at heart.

[spoiler]She actually wants to win an award to make her parents proud of her as her parents have ignored her and not acknowledged any of her achievements her whole life.[/spoiler]
